comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record removes spacer dowels to bond an aligned laminate sheet.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade latch release and coordinated withdrawal versus sequential support removal and irreversible flat placement of a sheet.
comparison.success_condition: Isolated terminal removal without damage versus all laminate bands bonded flat, registered, and released. Candidate force/damage thresholds remain unmeasured.
comparison.reason: The tested contact mechanics and failure modes are meaningfully different.
